name: codex-kanban
description: A Codex-native task board: projects, four columns, approvals, blockers, attachments and durable repository-local state, exposed through MCP tools and a local web board.

interface.shortDescription: A task board Codex can read and write
interface.longDescription: Codex Kanban gives Codex a task layer that outlives the conversation. Projects, four columns, automatic Needs you, blockers, questions with options, approvals, comments, activity and attachments, stored in a repository-local .kanban/board.json and exposed through native MCP tools. A local web board with search, filters and archive is included for humans.
defaultPrompt: Show me what needs my attention on the kanban board
Add a task for the login bug and put it in Backlog
